items.item_text: One or more Epic Clarity Data Model certifications (preferred)
At least 1-3 years of experience in a healthcare organization.
Equivalent experience in a programming/analytic/information systems role, with an emphasis on SQL programming.
Experience managing customer accounts or customer groups
Turn data needs into solutions that make an impact.

Join UCLA Health and help turn data into meaningful solutions that support better decision-making across the organization. As an Analytics Delivery Specialist, you’ll partner with stakeholders to understand their reporting and analytics needs, connect them with existing solutions, and help improve how analytics products are delivered and adopted.
Gather business needs and translate them into clear reporting and analytics requirements.
Identify and deliver existing EHR reporting tools and solutions that meet customer needs.
Triage reporting requests and EHR upgrade documentation.
Support workflow optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.
Facilitate access, training, and adoption of analytics products and self-service tools.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders and connect their needs with current and future analytics solutions.
Develop resources and marketing materials that increase awareness and utilization of available analytics products.
If you enjoy analytics, problem-solving, customer partnership, and translating business needs into practical solutions, this is an opportunity to make an impact across UCLA Health.

This flexible hybrid role allows for a blend of remote and on-site work, requiring presence on-site at least 10% of the time, within 48 hours of being asked to be on-site, and as needed based on operational requirements. Please note, travel to the “home office” location is not reimbursed. Each employee will complete a FlexWork Agreement with their manager to outline expectations and ensure mutual understanding. These arrangements are periodically reviewed and may be adjusted or terminated as necessary.
Salary offers are based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and internal equity. The University anticipates offering a salary between the minimum and midpoint of this range.
Proficiency in spreadsheet and database applications including Access, Excel, PowerPoint, and other database management and business intelligence software.
Superior analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment.
Knowledge of current issues in data management and SQL particularly in a healthcare environment including quality measurement, outcomes studies, healthcare finance, and patient safety (preferred)
Excellent interpersonal skills and exceptional judgment and discretion in interacting with physicians and senior management on sensitive political and confidential issues.

Technical skill and/or ability to acquire in-depth knowledge and use of Business Intelligence products with a solid knowledge of the Business Intelligence industry and data visualization best practices
